publications.title: ML based Smart e - Public Distribution System
publications.abstract: Presents an AI-enabled Public Distribution System incorporating facial recognition biometric verification, OTP fallback, crowd estimation queue monitoring, and integrated digital payment to ensure transparency, security, and reduced waiting times in government ration distribution.

publications.title: ML Based Fruit Health and Quality Analysis System
publications.abstract: Proposes a Multi-Modal Convolutional Neural Network (MMCNN) combining spatial features from RGB camera images and spectral dimensionality-reduced data via PCA to evaluate fruit disease and internal chemical quality indicators (sugar, moisture), optimized using Genetic Algorithms.
